object_description: two L-shaped buildings enclosing a playground
design_condition: The group fits well into the existing site and protects the recreational space, but interrupts the continuity of the natural landscape.

positive.statement: The idea of two buildings surrounding a playground is appreciated.
The group of buildings fits well into the existing site and protects the recreational space.
Structuring the primary school into two groups around a top-lit space is interesting.
The proposed architecture is simple and rational.
The openness to possible prefabrication is welcomed.
The outdoor spaces are pleasant and well designed.

negative.statement: The bus stop is not documented, the entrance area is cramped, and the covered courtyards are insufficient.
The glass wall separating the main entrance from the covered courtyard is not understood.
The WC and circulation blocks hamper future flexibility in the organization of spaces.
Choosing a ground-floor building for a full-day school is expensive.
The surface areas and volumes are slightly below the average for the projects.
